definitions.gloss: (not) at all; (not) in the least; by no means
definitions.explanation: Used with negative forms to emphasize that something has not happened or changed at all, despite expectations.

examples.japanese: {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。

examples.english: The rain shows no sign of stopping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理解|りかい}して→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I explain, they don't understand at all, which is frustrating.

notes:
Almost always used with a negative verb or adjective in the pattern {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + negative. Expresses frustration or emphasis that something has completely failed to change or happen. Stronger than simply using ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ alone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{構|かま}わない: I don't mind at all
- {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: hasn't changed at all
- {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧: making no progress at all
- {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|や}まない→止む：01153_yamu⟧: shows no sign of stopping
- {一向|いっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧: don't care at all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧: not at all — more casual, used in everyday speech
- ⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧: not at all, completely — similar emphasis but more versatile
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: not even a little — emphasizes the complete absence of something
- ⟦ちっとも→ちっとも：01663_chittomo⟧: not at all — casual, often expresses complaint or frustration
